about: Try Just Dance 2020 for free with the demo, available now! You can dance your heart out to kpop sensation 'Kill This Love' by BLACKPINK, or if you feel a bit more chill you can also dance to top hit 'Talk' by Khalid*.

Just Dance celebrates 10 years of bringing people together with new songs, new features and access to 500+ songs available in the Just Dance Unlimited catalogue. Every copy of the game comes with 1-month of free access!
